subject: REWRITE statement
notes: "The number of bytes ... after any changes made to the record length by the FORMAT clause shall not be larger than the largest or smaller than the smallest number of bytes allowed by the RECORD IS VARYING clause ... If this rule is violated ... '44'." The emitters pass the DEPENDING item's content as the length (13.18.43.4 GR13 a)) or -1 (image length); SequentialConnector.Rewrite and Stored (relative/indexed) return RecordSizeViolation '44' outside [VaryMin, VaryMax]. Probe pd.cob: LN=3 (below 5) -> 44, LN=25 (above 20) -> 44, record unchanged. The 'changes made ... by the FORMAT clause' qualifier is vacuous here: the FORMAT clause is Annex A.4.8, declared Not claimed in docs/CONFORMANCE.md (named decline), so no record length is ever FORMAT-changed. cite.py --check 14.9.35.4 GR20 -> OK. No spec-derived REWRITE test pins the bounds.
